overview_description.description: Arabian Gulf Steel Industries is a UAE-based steel manufacturer specializing in sustainable, net-zero steel production using recycled ferrous scrap and renewable energy. The company supplies high-quality steel products for construction, infrastructure, and industrial sectors while emphasizing environmental responsibility, innovation, and circular economy practices. AGSI aims to support regional development through advanced manufacturing technologies, operational efficiency, and reduced carbon emissions.
